caption:
The video captures a low-angle upward view through the canopy of a leafy tree. Broad glossy green leaves, some tinged yellow, form a rough ring around an opening of pale blue sky streaked with thin cloud. Near the top center of this opening a single white flower hangs open among the branches, while a slender bare twig dangles down into the central gap. The framing remains broadly steady, with the flower, the twig, and surrounding leaf clusters staying near the same positions relative to the edges.

The most obvious visible change is a small specular sun-glint that appears on right-side leaves near the middle of the canopy. It brightens a glossy leaf surface and remains visible thereafter, consistent with shifting light catching a leaf rather than a separate object entering the scene. Apart from this highlight, the foliage shows at most slight sway. The canopy, the open sky, and the dangling twig remain essentially as they are, with the glint appearing and persisting in place.
